rows.title: Growth Consulting Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

Growth Consulting is a strategy consulting practice powered by Circana and focused on driving profitable growth. The team works with senior management at some of the world’s largest consumer packaged goods, retail, general merchandise, and over-the-counter healthcare companies, as well as private equity firms. As an Analyst, you will work in small teams and directly with clients, playing an active role across all aspects of an engagement. You will join a growing practice that is uniquely positioned to help clients improve performance through speed to delivery, unparalleled data assets, industry-specific expertise, and a collaborative working style.

Job Responsibilities

Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Insights, Product, and Analytics) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success. Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay current on trends in consumer packaged goods, retail, and general merchandise to position Circana as a thought leader and trusted advisor. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. 

Requirements

An undergraduate degree, preferably in business, marketing, consumer insights, statistics, or economics. 0 to 4 years of relevant work experience, with strong communication, organization, and time management skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint and Excel) required; experience with market measurement or panel data such as Circana or NIQ preferred. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Chicago, New York, Remote 

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $80,000.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.descriptionText:
Department: 77-893 - Subscription - Digital Acquisition MediaLocation: UK - London

Description

The Senior Marketing Analyst will act as the analytical backbone of the Central Marketing team, turning complex marketing and customer data into clear, actionable insight that shapes budget decisions, campaign strategy, and channel performance across DAZN's markets. This role owns the reporting infrastructure that stakeholders rely on to understand marketing effectiveness, working closely with performance marketing, brand, and data engineering teams to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable, well-modelled data. The successful candidate will combine deep technical fluency in modern data tooling with a strong commercial understanding of marketing metrics, acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on what the numbers mean and what to do about them.

What You'll Be Doing:

Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting suites in Looker, ensuring marketing performance data is accurate, timely, and accessible to stakeholders across the businessWrite and optimise complex SQL queries in Snowflake to extract, transform, and model marketing and customer data from DAZN's data warehouseUse Deepnote (or similar notebook environments) for deeper ad-hoc analysis, exploratory data work, and building repeatable analytical workflowsQuery and interpret the GA4 export dataset in BigQuery, working directly with the raw event-level schema to support campaign measurement, attribution, and web/app behavioural analysisBuild and maintain Excel-based models and analyses where needed, including budget summaries, ad-hoc calculations, and stakeholder-ready outputsPartner with performance marketing, brand, and CRM teams to define and track key marketing metrics (e.g. CAC, ROAS, CPA, LTV, conversion rates)Translate business questions into structured analyses, presenting findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadershipSupport budget planning and allocation decisions with data-driven modelling across markets and channelsMaintain data governance standards for marketing datasets, including documentation of metric definitions and data lineageIdentify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and improve the efficiency of the analytics functionCollaborate with data engineering to influence the underlying data model where it affects marketing reporting needsMentor junior analysts on best practices in SQL, dashboarding, and analytical rigour

What You'll Bring:

Strong Looker skills, including familiarity with LookML (Looker's proprietary modeling language, not machine learning) — dashboard design and troubleshooting; full LookML fluency can be developed on the jobStrong Snowflake proficiency: writing efficient, well-structured SQL against large-scale datasets; understanding of warehouse performance and cost considerationsWorking knowledge of Deepnote (or comparable notebook tools such as Jupyter): comfortable using Python/SQL in a notebook environment for analysis beyond dashboardingConfident with Google Analytics and ExcelSolid grounding in marketing metrics and measurement frameworks across paid, owned, and earned channelsAbility to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholdersExperience working in fast-paced, multi-market organisations is a plus, ideally within media, streaming, or sports/entertainmentComfortable balancing competing stakeholder priorities and managing ambiguity

Benefits

Benefits include access to DAZN, 25 days’ annual leave (increasing by 3 days after 3 years), private medical insurance, life assurance, pension contributions up to 5%, family friendly community including enhanced parental leave, electric vehicle benefit option, learning and development resources, opportunity for flexible working, and access to our internal speaker series and events.

About The Role

As a Senior Systems Engineer in our Autonomous Mobility & Delivery (AM&D) group, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of autonomous transportation at Uber.

You will be responsible for the safety of the technical frameworks that allow Uber to integrate seamlessly with various autonomous vehicle (AV) partners while developing our own internal autonomous offerings. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge robotics, safety-critical systems, and complex platform integration. This role is on Uber's Autonomous Mobility and Delivery Safety team and reports to the Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, Autonomous Mobility & Delivery Autonomous Mobility & Delivery.

What You Will Need / Bonus Points

---- What You Will Do ----

Define partner-agnostic solutions: Develop and standardize technical safety solutions and frameworks that expedite the go-to-market process for diverse autonomous vehicle tech providers and AV fleet operators on the Uber platform.Define safety requirements for Uber-built autonomous offerings: Lead the elicitation and documentation of high-level and detailed system safety requirements for Uber's proprietary autonomous technology and platform services.Develop V&V strategies: Design comprehensive Verification and Validation (V&V) strategies for both internal Uber solutions and the complex technical interactions between Uber's platform and external AV Partner systems to ensure solutions meet Uber's safety bar.Safety Risk Assessment: Lead technical safety risk assessments to ensure that all AV partner integrations meet Uber's rigorous safety and performance standards.Influence Strategic Decisions: Act as a technical subject matter expert to influence long-term product roadmaps and strategic partnerships, ensuring technical feasibility and safety are at the forefront of business decisions.

Apply AI responsibly: Evaluate and integrate AI/ML-driven approaches to enhance safety validation and risk identification, while ensuring appropriate oversight, traceability, and compliance with safety standards.

Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.7+ years of experience in systems engineering, with a significant focus on complex hardware/software integrations.Proven track record in the Autonomous Vehicle industry, specifically within safety-critical systems.Experience with V&V methodologies (e.g., ISO 26262, SOTIF/ISO 21448).

Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a relevant engineering discipline.Experience defining cross-functional system architectures for large-scale distributed systems.Strong ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.Experience leveraging AI/ML tools in engineering workflows or safety analysis

rows.title: U.S Immigration Manager
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Uber Global Relocation & Immigration team is looking for a Manager to own the U.S. Immigration program from strategy through execution. In this role, you will define the strategic direction, governance framework, and long-term roadmap for Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.

The U.S. immigration program is a critical enabler of Uber's talent strategy, supporting the hiring, retention, and mobility of foreign national employees while ensuring compliance with evolving U.S. immigration regulations.

The U.S. Immigration Manager will report directly to the Head of Global Relocation & Immigration and sit on the GRI leadership team. You will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, business leaders, immigration counsel, and external service providers to ensure Uber's immigration program effectively supports business objectives while delivering an exceptional stakeholder experience.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Own the strategy, governance, and execution of Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.  Lead end-to-end U.S. immigration programs, including H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, TN, L-1, O-1, F-1 OPT/STEM OPT, E-2, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Adjustment of Status, Consular Processing, and ongoing work authorization compliance requirements.  Serve as the primary strategic partner to Talent Acquisition, Legal, HR, and business leaders on immigration solutions, workforce planning, talent retention, and organizational growth.  Define and drive the U.S. immigration strategy, policies, governance frameworks, and program roadmap, identifying opportunities to improve scalability, compliance, stakeholder experience, efficiency, and business outcomes.  Own immigration vendor governance, including strategic relationship management, performance accountability, compliance oversight, commercial stewardship, and executive business reviews.  Own governance of U.S. immigration escalations, providing senior decision-making for high-risk, high-visibility, and complex immigration matters, while leveraging escalation trends and root cause insights to drive continuous program improvement.  Monitor regulatory developments and emerging immigration trends, assessing business impact and proactively advising stakeholders on readiness and risk mitigation strategies.  Define immigration program success metrics, compliance outcomes, vendor governance expectations, and strategic KPIs, using data and insights to drive continuous improvement and measurable business impact.  Leverage technology, automation, AI, and analytics to drive strategic improvements, optimize program performance, and shape the future-state immigration technology roadmap in partnership with the GRI Experience Program Manager.  Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance immigration programs and deliver measurable business impact across the employee lifecycle.  Prepare and deliver strategic recommendations, program insights, and performance updates to senior leadership.  Own the U.S. immigration budget, including forecasting, financial planning, vendor spend management, and budget-to-actual reviews.  Build and maintain strong partnerships with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, and business leaders, influencing decisions and positioning immigration as a strategic enabler of Uber's talent objectives.  Lead, coach, and develop the U.S. Immigration Specialist (L4), providing strategic direction, prioritization, performance management, and career development. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 8+ years of U.S. business immigration experience, demonstrating deep expertise in employment-based immigration laws, regulations, and compliance requirements.  5+ program management experience, with the ability to lead complex initiatives from strategy through execution.  5+ years operating in complex, matrixed organizations, partnering with Senior level stakeholders to drive strategic initiatives. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities, with a track record of developing scalable programs and delivering measurable business impact.  Experience managing external immigration vendors, including governance, performance management, commercial oversight, vendor selection, and contract management.  Strong analytical skills, with experience leveraging data, technology, and automation to improve program effectiveness and stakeholder experience.  Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions at all levels of the organization.  Passion for delivering exceptional employee and stakeholder experiences.

About The Role

As the Sales Compensation Business Partner, you'll own the total rewards strategy and incentive design for a fast-moving business and its sales population, connecting the dots across Talent Acquisition, Sales, Finance, HR, and business leadership. This is a broad, high-ownership role: you'll design pay structures and incentive plans, guide hiring decisions, own leveling and benchmarking, and advise executives, translating complex business needs into pay practices that are equitable and market-competitive. It takes financial acumen, strong data-modeling skills, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders through clear, credible communication.

Responsibilities

 Plan Design & Strategy: Partner with Sales Operations and Sales Leadership to help design end-to-end sales incentive compensation plans that drive strategic behaviors, market share expansion, and margin growth.  Experience: Minimum of 6 years (8 preferred) of direct experience in sales compensation design, sales operations, financial planning & analysis (FP&A). Technical Skills: Advanced data modeling skills (Excel/Google Sheets) and hands-on experience with modern commission software (e.g., CaptivateIQ, Spiff, Xactly) and CRM tools (Salesforce). Here at HSBC we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We’re bringing together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share.

The individual filling this role, Manager, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Analytics, will be part of a team managing campaign execution, campaign fulfillment and campaign tracking/analysis processes for the US Intl Wealth & Premier Banking (IWPB) business. rows.title: Safety Measurement & Insights Lead
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Safety Risk Measurement & Insights Lead owns how Uber defines, measures, and reasons about safety risk on the platform. This role makes us smart about measurement itself - ensuring that our indicators of safety risk (both outcome metrics like Safety Incident Rate and the leading, input, and predictive signals that precede harm) are well-defined, governed, trusted, and continuously improved, and then translating them into clear, actionable insight for business leadership and external reporting.

This role sits at the center of Analytics, Operations, and cross-functional partners to unify metric definitions, strengthen data quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve how safety performance is understood and acted upon across the organization. This role will also help shape how Safety uses smarter tooling and AI-enabled workflows to scale measurement, analytics, and reporting.

What You'll Do

Metric Governance & Foundations:  Drive governance for Safety's most critical metrics, including Incident Rate and leading indicators of safety risk. Recommend durable definitions, inclusion/exclusion logic, auditability, lineage, and consistency over time. Ensure metric frameworks remain credible as the platform, product, and risk landscape evolve.

Data Quality & Measurement Integrity:  Serve as Safety's measurement steward - lead end-to-end accountability for the quality and reliability of safety data. Partner with DS / Eng / Ops to resolve issues, and establish clear monitoring and escalation mechanisms that improve trust in reported safety outcomes.

Analytical Investigation, Insight Generation & Business Translation: Lead deep dives into performance shifts, emerging risks, and measurement anomalies, combining quantitative analysis with operational context to identify what is happening, why it is happening, and what Safety should do next; then turn those insights into crisp, credible narratives that help leaders make decisions, prioritize investments, and communicate clearly to senior stakeholders.

AI-Enabled Insights & Scalable Workflows: Define and advance the future state of Safety analytics by identifying opportunities to automate recurring analysis, improve self-serve access, and use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate insight generation without compromising rigor

Safety Ops Enablement:  Enable Safety Operations and regional partners to use trusted safety metrics consistently and effectively. Build or shape dashboards, reporting tools, education materials, and analytical resources that improve understanding, speed up decision-making, and strengthen stakeholder influence.

Reporting & Decision Support:  Ensure executive- and external-facing reporting is rigorous, defensible, and efficient, with clear underlying methodology and a consistent measurement framework.

What You'll Need

 Analytical Leadership & Data Acumen: Strong analytical foundation with the ability to understand statistical concepts, challenge assumptions, partner credibly with Data Science, and turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.  Business Acumen & Strategic Thinking: Strong understanding of the broader business context and Safety's role within it, with the ability to frame trends, tradeoffs, and recommendations in a way that supports executive decision-making.  Influence & Communication: Excellent communicator and storyteller with a track record of building trust, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and driving alignment without direct authority.  Systems Thinking: Able to understand end-to-end processes, dependencies, and organizational dynamics to identify root causes and durable solutions.  AI & Analytical Innovation: Curious and practical user of AI, automation, or emerging analytical tools to accelerate insight generation, improve decision-making, and scale analytical work. 

Basic Qualifications 

 8+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, business operations, data science, or a related field.  Bachelor's Degree in Economics, Engineering , Data Science, Finance or technical field. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience in Trust & Safety, Risk, Marketplace Integrity, Fraud, or other complex operational domains.  Experience at a technology platform, marketplace, gig economy, e-commerce, social media, dating, or similar trust-based ecosystem.  Experience defining, governing, or evolving critical business metrics used by senior leadership.  Experience building self-service analytics, measurement frameworks, or analytical products.  Track record of coaching, educating, or upskilling teams on analytical concepts and best practices.  Experience driving accountability and raising the quality bar for insight generation across an organization.  PHD in Economics, Engineering , Data science, Finance or technical field. 

 Why This Role Matters 

This role ensures Safety has the measurement foundations it needs to make good decisions, hold the right line on rigor, and communicate performance credibly inside and outside the company. It is both a governance role and an insight role: trusted numbers, better decisions, stronger execution.

Job Description

Our Opportunity:

Chewy is seeking a Voice Programs and Experience Strategy Lead to join our Merchandising Operations organization. This role will lead the strategy for how we gather, interpret, and act on feedback across vendors, Category Managers, other internal users of the Chewy Partner Hub, and related support workflows. This person will help Chewy better understand who our users are, what they are trying to accomplish, where they experience friction, and how those pain points should inform product, process, enablement, and support decisions.

This is a highly strategic role for a builder who can create structure where it does not exist today. The right candidate will be able to design listening mechanisms, connect anecdotal feedback to operational and financial data, identify patterns across multiple channels, and turn those insights into compelling business cases that influence roadmaps and drive measurable change. This role is critical to improving vendor and user experience over time, increasing trust in our tools and support model, and helping Chewy prioritize the right investments for the greatest impact.

Our ideal candidate has strong business judgment, experience operating in ambiguity, and a passion for improving people’s lives through better tools, workflows, and experiences. They are a strong communicator who earns trust quickly, sees connections others miss, and can translate feedback, data, observation, and context into a clear narrative that drives action.

What You’ll Do

Own the strategy for voice programs and experience improvement across vendors, Category Managers, other internal users of the Chewy Partner Hub, and related workflows.Design and scale feedback mechanisms across multiple channels, including surveys, interviews, roundtables, workflow reviews, targeted module feedback, ticket-response analysis, and other structured listening channels.Build and maintain a centralized feedback-to-action process that consolidates insights across channels, identifies recurring themes, routes issues to the right partner teams, and tracks action through completion.Translate qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear business problem statements, impact statements, desired outcomes, and prioritized recommendations for Product, Operations, Enablement, and other cross-functional teams.Partner with Product and related stakeholders to influence roadmap prioritization by connecting user pain points to operational, adoption, financial, and experience data.Develop practical frameworks for vendor types, user types, and key workflows so feedback can be interpreted in the right context and prioritization can be based on user impact, not only dollar value.Identify where pain points should be addressed through product changes, process redesign, training, help content, support model changes, or other interventions – then partner with rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

At Chewy, taking care of pets and the people who love them through the highs, the lows, and the everyday is what drives us. Grounded in that purpose and focused on our mission to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere, we work every day to help people feel more confident, supported, and capable in caring for the animals they love—showing up with the products, services, care, and guidance they need, whenever they need it.

Bringing that to life takes exceptional leaders.

Leadership at Chewy is guided by our Operating Principles, which define how we lead, make decisions, develop talent, serve our customers, and grow our business. We value leaders who think strategically, stay close to the customer, and aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves alongside their teams. They solve complex challenges, build high-performing organizations, and partner closely with senior leaders to shape the future of Chewy.

If you're energized by building, leading, and making a meaningful impact, this leadership opportunity may be the right fit for you.

Your Opportunity

Chewy is seeking a Director, Paid Social Media to lead one of the most visible and strategically important growth areas in our marketing portfolio. This leader will own our paid social strategy across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest and emerging platforms, helping Chewy create brand awareness, demand, deepen engagement, and acquire high-quality customers in the places where pet parents increasingly search, discover, evaluate, and shop.

This is a high-impact opportunity to shape how Chewy shows up across the modern social ecosystem. You will lead a significant paid social investment and build the strategy, operating model, creative testing systems, measurement approach, and team capabilities required to make Chewy one of the most trusted, talked-about, and effective social brands in the pet category and beyond.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic growth leader and a deep paid social operator. You understand the distinct role each platform can play across the customer journey, and you know how to match the right creative, audience, bid strategy, and measurement approach to the right business objective. You are fluent in platform-native creative, full-funnel analytics, AI-enabled testing, and the realities of measuring social impact in a noisy attribution environment.

This role reports into the Head of Social Media & Editorial within Chewy’s Performance Media organization, with meaningful visibility to VP, C-suite, and cross-functional senior leaders. You will partner closely with Brand, Creative, Influencer, Marketing Science, Finance, Product, Martech, Merchandising, and agency/platform partners to connect platform attention to downstream business outcomes, including high-quality sessions, purchase intent, branded demand, gross adds, CAC, revenue, LTV, and contribution profit.

What You’ll Do

Lead Chewy’s full-funnel paid social strategy across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, defining the role of each channel across awareness, consideration, acquisition, retention, and demand creation.Own paid social investment strategy, budget allocation, scaling criteria, efficiency guardrails, and test-and-learn priorities across a significant scaled media portfolio.Build and improve the paid social operating model across campaign architecture, audience strategy, bidding, creative testing, signal quality, reporting, and optimization.Partner with Brand, Media Comms, Creative, Influencer, and agency teams to develop a high-velocity, platform-native creative testing engine across hooks, formats, creators, offers, products, categories, and customer segments.Drive high-quality demand to Chewy by improving the volume, quality, and purchase intent of sessions generated through paid social.Partner with Marketing Science, Finance, Martech, and Product to evolve measurement across platform attribution, incrementality, lift studies, MMM, signal quality, and downstream business contribution.Translate platform and media performance into executive-ready narratives that connect reach, views, engagement, clicks, and site/app behavior to business outcomes such as branded demand, gross adds, CAC, revenue, LTV, and contribution profit.Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of digital marketing managers, platform channel leads, and agency partners.

What You’ll Need

12+ years of experience in paid social, performance marketing, growth marketing, or digital media, with progressive ownership of large-scale paid media programs.5+ years of people leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and developing strong operators into strategic business leaders.Deep fluency in paid social and video platforms, with the ability to guide channel strategy, challenge platform recommendations, and coach teams on platform-specific best practices.A track record of scaling full-funnel paid social programs that drive measurable outcomes across awareness, consideration, acquisition, retention, customer quality, and long-term value.Hands-on depth in the core mechanics of paid social, including campaign architecture, audience strategy, bidding, optimization, creative testing, signal quality, event tracking, automation, and performance reporting.Demonstrated ability to improve performance through platform-native creative, rapid experimentation, audience insights, and disciplined learning agendas.Experience managing significant media budgets and making investment recommendations tied to revenue, CAC, ROAS, LTV, contribution profit, incrementality, and enterprise priorities.Experience with AI -enabled creative analytics, automated variation testing, modular creative systems, or rapid content experimentation at scale.Comfort making decisions in imperfect attribution environments, using a mix of platform data, incrementality testing, brand or conversion lift, MMM, and downstream business signals.Ecommerce, retail, marketplace, subscription, or high-velocity consumer growth experience, with an understanding of category strategy, merchandising priorities, customer lifecycle, and margin-aware growth.Executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, debate tradeoffs, influence senior stakeholders, and turn data into clear strategic recommendations.

Bonus

Experience scaling paid social within a large retail, ecommerce, marketplace, subscription, or consumer brand environment.Experience with signal strategy, including pixel/CAPI, event quality, privacy-safe measurement, audience signals, and automated bidding governance.Experience with creator-led paid media, Spark Ads, whitelisting/allowlisting, affiliate creator amplification, or influencer-to-paid social workflows.Passion for pets, culture-first creative, and building paid social programs that earn attention, create demand, and drive measurable business impact.

What You’ll Get

A place where you can be your authentic self and grow your career. Our pet parents and partners are from everywhere — different places and different walks of life. It is what makes them unique. Likewise, Chewtopians are encouraged to bring their perspectives to deliver on our mission.Work in a culture that cares, with managers who value you and your career journey. Be empowered to think big, deliver results, and become your best.Opportunities to build meaningful connections with a diverse group of Chewtopians through Team Member Resource Groups and inclusive company events, programs, and activities.Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, in addition to wellness programs and resources that enable you to be your best self in and outside of work.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at one of our corporate offices in McLean, VA or New York City, NY

At Hilton, we are leveraging partners, commercial opportunities, guest experience and data to drive value for our guests, owners and enterprise. Our mission is to deliver high-impact, efficient media solutions that connect global partners to meaningful audiences while preserving the integrity of the guest experience.

Reporting to the Vice President, Commercial Partnerships, the Director, Partnerships will be is focused on leading new business development and supporting launch, activation and partner relationships for all data, and CMN partnerships. Collaborate across marketing, loyalty and other partnerships teams to more broadly develop these relationships into commercial opportunities. A focus on securing and growing the value of new Partnerships across key categories, including travel, retail, entertainment, media, lifestyle, luxury, wellness, amongst others.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, business development, media, and commercialization. The ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, negotiation prowess, with experience building and scaling commercial partnership.

As a key member of the Commerce Media Network (CMN) leadership team, you will help shape the future of Hilton's commercial partnerships ecosystem, developing solutions that create value for guests, partners, owners, and Hilton, while upholding the trust and brand standards that define the Hilton experience.

This position represents the business interests of both Hilton and each Partner, with the primary goal of creating commercial value from Hilton's assets and activating all partnerships across the Program's global products and platforms to create incremental value and demonstrable ROI for Program and Partners alike. The role is focused on the new business development and optimization of a robust partnership sales pipeline & process, onboarding model, and growth strategy to secure, develop, launch, activate, and grow the value of strategically aligned partnerships with high-profile brands that accelerate member engagement and drive sustainable revenue generation for Hilton.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Work with the CMN leadership & cross-functional teams to develop and execute a data & media partnership business development plan - focused on partnership categories, across domestic and global markets - adding new partners to support commercial goals, while delivering value to members and brand affinity to the Program and partners alike. Continuously monitor the competitive landscape to inform the strategic direction.Oversee developing and maintaining a healthy pipeline of prospective partners across leading B2C (& possibly B2B) categories and brands. Establish and optimize an integrated sales process with other business units to support revenue growth from new partnerships. Oversee contract negotiations to onboard new partners, ensuring contract compliance with intercompany agreements.In partnership with the Head of Media & Ad Product, develop pricing frameworks, packaging strategies and forecasting models, Hilton's assets to maximize revenue and contribution margin.Support the team to create and execute best in class Partnership experiences, products, operating models and marketing campaigns for new Partnerships, to generate buzz, bring the value of the Program to life for members across all categories of discretionary consumer spend, and maximize ROI for all stakeholders.Work in partnership with other Hilton business units to develop and execute the strategy to collaborate, cross-sell and further monetize Partnerships in collaboration with teams leading new and emerging opportunities to expand the value of Partnerships and member data.Establish standards for campaign measurement, audience performance, and business impact reporting.Partner with Technology and Data teams to operationalize ad tech integrations, measurement frameworks (including incrementality and attribution), and performance reporting that enable closed-loop insights and operational efficiency.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Work closely with the Vice President, Commercial Partnerships to align product priorities with enterprise strategy, P&L objectives, and governance guardrails.Partner the Head of Media & Ad Products to develop media kits, rate cards, playbooks, and commercialization frameworks that accelerate pipeline conversion and advertiser retention.Collaborate with Marketing, Technology, Legal/Privacy, Brand, Digital, Loyalty, and Finance teams to ensure product execution aligns with Hilton's guest-first standards, brand integrity, and compliance requirements.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

The CMN partnership roadmap and pipeline, including aligning with the Hilton Honors, media and other partnership teams.CMN pricing models including packaging media and other assets to create packages & programs to maximize the commercial value of Hilton's assets and data.Client Success metrics and ensuing we reach agreed upon partner objectives.

rows.title: Senior Ontologist, Biologics Discovery
rows.descriptionText:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Data Science

Job Category

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Beerse, Antwerp, Belgium, Madrid, Spain, Raritan, New Jersey, United States of America, Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America, Titusville, New Jersey, United States of America

Job Description

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

About The Opportunity

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Senior Ontologist dedicated to our Biologics Discovery organization. This is a horizontal, cross-cutting role that owns the semantic foundation touching every dataset and every team: how antibody, protein engineering, assay, automation, sequence, external partner, and discovery portfolio data are connected, governed, discovered, and reused. You will be a hands-on ontologist and cross-functional catalyst, turning complex scientific language into reusable ontologies, controlled vocabularies, mappings, and semantic standards.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; Beerse, BE, or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

USA - Requisition Number: R-099961

Spain - Requisition Number: R-100659

Belgium - Requisition Number: R-100662

Why This Role Matters

Biologics data is generated across many systems and teams, often with terminology that differs by source, which limits how well scientists and models can find, compare, and reuse it. This role provides the semantic connective tissue that makes that data computable, interoperable, and AI-ready across the Discovery portfolio and with CMC partners, aligning to enterprise standards rather than reinventing them, so semantics remain durable as platforms evolve.

Position Summary

As a Senior Ontologist for Biologics Discovery, you will design, build, test, publish, and govern semantic models that enable knowledge graphs, data products, search, analytics, and AI/ML across biologics workflows. You will partner with experimental scientists, computational biologists, data scientists, data engineers, platform teams, and IT to capture domain semantics and translate them into well-structured ontology modules, and you will set the semantic standards adopted across the team's data products.

A core purpose of this work is to make our data agent-ready: agentic AI systems cannot reliably navigate, interpret, or act on scientific data without the shared vocabularies, relationships, and constraints that ontologies provide. You will build the semantic layer that lets agents ground their reasoning, retrieve the right data, and connect evidence across experiments, turning fragmented data into knowledge that both scientists and AI can act on.

You will align biologics semantics to our enterprise semantic and governance standards, and collaborate with peer ontologists supporting Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) in the Therapeutics Development & Supply organization so Discovery and downstream semantics stay aligned across the molecule lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Ontology Design, Release & Standards

Model, code, test, and release validated, versioned ontology modules, controlled vocabularies, and mappings across biologics discovery domains, including antibody and protein engineering, assay metadata, molecular design, profiling, automation outputs, sequence/construct knowledge, and developability signals.Publish ontology packages as API-ready semantic assets consumable by knowledge graphs, data products, and AI/ML workflows.Partner closely with biologists, assay scientists, automation teams, and other domain experts to elicit, refine, and translate complex scientific concepts into computable semantic models, balancing scientific accuracy with practical usability and adoption.Express scientific and operational concepts as OWL/RDF classes and properties, SKOS vocabularies, SHACL constraints, and reusable design patterns, and establish the semantic standards adopted across the team's data products.

Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Integration

Partner with data engineers to embed semantic layers into data pipelines, catalogs, and knowledge graph platforms.Model not only scientific entities and concepts, but also the processes, workflows, experimental activities, and decision points that generate and govern those entities, providing the context necessary for interoperability, provenance, and reuse.Enable entity linking, classification, normalization, provenance capture, and semantic search across biologics datasets, and ground agentic AI and retrieval workflows (e.g., knowledge graph and GraphRAG approaches) so agents can reliably navigate, interpret, and act on scientific data.Build and maintain semantic queries (e.g., SPARQL) and automated validation measuring semantic coverage, conformance, lineage, and completeness.

Enterprise & Cross-Functional Alignment

Own semantic alignment with enterprise data governance and knowledge graph standards so Biologics Discovery builds on shared enterprise assets rather than duplicating governance.Harmonize terminology and models with peer ontologists supporting downstream development (CMC) across process, manufacturing, quality, and product lifecycle data, ensuring discovery-to-development handoffs remain traceable and interoperable.Drive consensus across scientific, informatics, and data teams on ontology scope, definitions, and adoption, representing Discovery's semantic needs in enterprise forums.Apply modeling guidelines, naming and versioning conventions, change management, deprecation rules, and semantic quality checks aligned to enterprise governance.

Why This Role Is Unique

This is a rare opportunity to define the semantic foundation for Biologics Discovery and to work at one of its most strategic cross-organizational interfaces: the alignment with enterprise data governance and downstream development partners. You will shape how breakthrough biologics knowledge is captured, connected, governed, and made actionable for scientists and AI systems.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a builder, translator, and systems thinker who is knowledgeable about biologics discovery and energized by its potential to impact human health. They can discuss the science fluently with experimental teams, design rigorous semantic models with technical peers, translate complex biology into machine-readable formats, represent Discovery credibly with enterprise and development partners, and advocate for governance that makes data more reusable without slowing innovation. They are motivated above all by turning connected biologics knowledge into faster, better medicines for patients.

Qualifications

Required

Advanced degree in Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.3+ years in ontology engineering, knowledge modeling, taxonomy design, semantic standards, or knowledge graph development.Hands-on experience with versioning, change management, validation, and release workflows for ontology assets.Proficiency with OWL, RDF(S), SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL, and ontology design patterns.Experience with graph/semantic technologies (e.g., Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, Protégé, RDF triple stores).Ability to translate scientific discussions into semantic models, validation tests, and delivery plans, and to align semantics across teams and partner organizations.Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills in a matrixed R&D environment.Working knowledge of how ontologies and knowledge graphs ground AI and agentic retrieval (e.g., semantic search, RAG, or GraphRAG approaches).

Preferred

Experience in biologics, antibody design, protein engineering, assay biology, or high-throughput experimentation.Experience operating in a governed enterprise environment, preferably pharma or biotech, applying FAIR data principles and enabling interoperability across research and development handoffs.Experience integrating ontology assets into data pipelines, knowledge graphs, search, or agentic AI / GraphRAG tools.Familiarity with OBO Foundry ontologies, UMLS, GO, ChEBI, UniProt, HL7/FHIR, or CDISC.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; Beerse, BE, or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are under 18 years of age, you (the candidate) may need to obtain the necessary working papers or other documentation required by state law to start the assignment, as well as get a parent’s consent for the background check.

Johnson & Johnson is committed to providing an interview process that is inclusive of our applicants’ needs. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers , internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.

The anticipated base pay range for this position is $109,000 to $174,800. The Company maintains highly competitive, performance-based compensation programs. Description & Requirements

Challenging. Surprising. Fast-paced. Purposeful. Life at Bloomberg is many things, but it’s never dull. We’re a truly global business with a truly diverse workforce. We pride ourselves on being open, inclusive and collaborative, providing a work environment that inspires our employees to be their best. At Bloomberg, we work on purpose. All of us engage in meaningful work, delivering leading edge products and solutions that shape the industry and are critical to our customers. You’ll also get to work at a company that lives its values and provides employees with opportunities to give back. Whether you thrive on the energy of a newsroom, the pace of a trading floor, or the buzz of a recent tech breakthrough, we’ll give you more than a job. We’ll give you the opportunity to do amazing work you couldn’t do anywhere else.

Our Team

An exciting and new opportunity has opened up to join the Bloomberg Product Oversight team in New York. Our team dives deep into the very roots of our clients' workflow to gain a comprehensive understanding of their business. We align our clients' workflow and data consumption with the appropriate contractual framework and Bloomberg offering, protecting both our clients and our organization. Using a consultative and analytical approach, we examine client data workflows, content licensing frameworks, and strategic initiatives working closely across all internal lines of business. With close proximity to our clients, we are at the forefront of understanding business and product opportunities, providing these insights to management to better improve our offerings.

What's the role? 

In today's complex environment, data analytics and business intelligence are critical to understanding performance and opportunities to improve service and optimize efficiency. We are seeking a Data Scientist to expand the foundation we've developed, utilizing the wealth of data embedded across our organization to drive innovation and groundbreaking change. As an integral member of the team, you will go beyond collection and synthesis of data to help us determine potential opportunities for strategic improvement. You will also accomplish this through project management tools, operational dashboards, KPIs/metrics, and written/verbal presentation skills.

Who You Are

You're a Data Scientist/Engineer with a strong programming background. You have proven project and time management skills. You multi-task effectively, handle ambiguity, and function well in a fast-paced, sometimes unpredictable environment. You approach challenges with creativity and enthusiasm. You thrive in a team environment and possess the motivation and curiosity to learn the details of Bloomberg businesses and how our team operates.

On our team, you will apply data analysis expertise to complex operational problems. You'll provide design recommendations, identify data sources, and gather/cleanse/model and test your ideas. We'll Trust You To

 Design end-to-end machine learning models to answer targeted business questions and drive change Perform large-scale data analysis and manipulations to extract insights and influence business decisions Organize and analyze data to identify historical patterns to better position our workflows Integrate yourself into the team in close partnership with other analysts on department wide initiatives Research, develop, and implement new methods of extracting relevant data from a variety of sources Collaborate and consult with business colleagues to better understand their domain Design, prototype, and implement technical solutions using a combination of proprietary, third party and open-source technology to pursue complex business needs

You'll Need To Have

 5+ years of data science/machine learning experience Strong foundational programming skills with deep expertise in Python and SQL Ability to write clean, efficient, and optimized code for data processing, analysis and model deployment Hands-on experience in building end-to-end machine learning models with post-deployment best practices Ability to assimilate, decipher, and present data analysis from a client impact perspective Ability to run multiple projects at a time and shift priorities quickly Strong analytical skills, troubleshooting, and ability to trace root causes Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills

We'd Love To See

 Experience with client services within the tech/financial industry Strong knowledge of supervised and unsupervised anomaly detection algorithms Experience with big data tools and infrastructure (Hadoop, Spark...)

What’s it like to work here? 

We work hard. We are ambitious and set ourselves tough business goals. We are a meritocracy where everyone has a voice - not a job title. Working with people you trust, respect, and can collaborate with is more important than titles or position. Things move fast, and we want people who will enjoy working in this environment and feed off the energy. But it isn’t all about work. Giving back is one of our core values, and there are many ways to get involved in philanthropic initiatives from helping local school kids with their reading to helping clean up local parks and waterways.

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know that the next steps are.

rows.title: Vice President, Consumer Products & Growth - CouponFollow
rows.descriptionText:
About CouponFollow

At CouponFollow (NextGen), a System1 company (NYSE: SST), we help over 25 million monthly users save money by connecting them with real, verified coupon codes from thousands of leading retailers. As one of the world’s leading organic coupon sites, CouponFollow.com, we're rapidly expanding our product offerings, user experience, and strategic partnerships.

About The Role

We are looking for a Vice President, Consumer Products & Growth to take end-to-end ownership of our browser extension and related mobile apps business, as well as new strategic growth products in the deals and savings space. This is a hybrid business owner / growth / product-owner role. You'll set the strategy for how we grow these businesses: marketing, installs, retention, and monetization, own the partner relationships that make that growth possible, and work hand-in-hand with product and engineering to ship the roadmap that gets us there. You will be the single point of accountability for the business's performance and growth trajectory.

Responsibilities

 Strategy & Business Ownership 

 Own the extension and related business plans and operating cadence, with accountability for revenue, forecasting, KPI performance, and resource allocation; identify performance gaps early and lead corrective actions across the organization.  Define the growth strategy for the consumer product portfolio, setting the strategic priorities, growth levers, and market-positioning choices that will drive sustainable scale.  Set strategic product direction and roadmap priorities to enhance the product experience and business metrics.  Source and prioritize new business opportunities, evaluating build-vs-partner tradeoffs and sizing potential impact.  Build and scale a high-performing team to drive the business, establishing clear processes, staffing models, and quality standards to maintain strong user experience as volume grows. 

 Performance & Analytics 

 Own performance management of the CouponFollow browser extensions and mobile apps — analyzing, interpreting, and reporting on funnel, acquisition, retention, and cashback performance data.  Establish the reporting cadence and metrics framework the business is run against, surfacing insights and recommendations to leadership. 

 Growth Partnerships & Distribution 

 Own the strategy and execution for performance-based CPA/CPI partnerships that drive installs, activation, and monetization.  Manage the creator/UGC growth function against clear performance targets.  Build and grow high-value partner distribution relationships across affiliate networks, merchants, and other distribution partners, with a clear focus on scalable, pay-for-performance models.  Design, test, and optimize CPA (cost per action) and CPI (cost per install) offers, payout structures, and tracking frameworks to maximize efficient growth and LTV.  Work closely with the partnerships team to align affiliate network and merchant relationships with the extension/app business, ensuring clear KPIs, attribution, and payout accountability.  Define and track partner performance metrics (e.g., eCPI, eCPA, ROAS, retention cohorts) and run regular partner reviews to scale winners and cut underperformers. 

 Compliance & Risk 

 Ensure compliance with tracking technologies, digital marketing standards, and affiliate network stand-down rules.  Collaborate with product, data, and legal to ensure compliant tracking, fraud prevention, and clean integration of partner-sourced traffic into the extension funnel. 

 Cross-functional Execution 

 Manage and develop the paid growth function responsible for day-to-day channel execution - approve budgets, targets, and LTV-based guardrails while holding the team accountable for efficient, scalable growth.  Partner closely with product and engineering to translate strategy into a shipped roadmap.  Act as the connective tissue between partnerships, product, engineering, and leadership to keep the extension business aligned and moving. 

Required Qualifications

 8+ years of relevant experience with responsibility for consumer and product activities (e.g. product growth, product management, GM or P&L owner).  Demonstrated success developing and scaling performance-based growth programs, including CPA/CPI partnerships, affiliate channels, or other pay-for-performance distribution models.  Proven track record building, launching, and maintaining high-scale, successful products.  Experience strategically influencing and aligning senior stakeholders and key partners to consistently drive action, results, and change.  Hands-on, "roll up your sleeves" mindset, with the ability to be a driver and change agent in an organization.  Strong business acumen and data analytics proficiency.  Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, marketing, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 

Nice To Have

 Experience managing app and/or browser extension products.  Experience in affiliate marketing or digital partnerships.  Experience in the shopping and deals space. 

What We Have To Offer

Competitive salary + bonus + equityGenerous PTO + 11 company holidaysOpen sick time100% covered Medical, Dental, Vision for employees401k with matchHealth & Dependent Care Flex Spending Account Paid professional developmentLeadership & growth opportunitiesVirtual company and team building events

Equal Employment Opportunity

System1 provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Job Description

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

About The Opportunity

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Senior Ontologist dedicated to our Biologics Discovery organization. This is a horizontal, cross-cutting role that owns the semantic foundation touching every dataset and every team: how antibody, protein engineering, assay, automation, sequence, external partner, and discovery portfolio data are connected, governed, discovered, and reused. You will be a hands-on ontologist and cross-functional catalyst, turning complex scientific language into reusable ontologies, controlled vocabularies, mappings, and semantic standards.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; Beerse, BE, or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

USA - Requisition Number: R-099961

Spain - Requisition Number: R-100659

Belgium - Requisition Number: R-100662

Why This Role Matters

Biologics data is generated across many systems and teams, often with terminology that differs by source, which limits how well scientists and models can find, compare, and reuse it. This role provides the semantic connective tissue that makes that data computable, interoperable, and AI-ready across the Discovery portfolio and with CMC partners, aligning to enterprise standards rather than reinventing them, so semantics remain durable as platforms evolve.

Position Summary

As a Senior Ontologist for Biologics Discovery, you will design, build, test, publish, and govern semantic models that enable knowledge graphs, data products, search, analytics, and AI/ML across biologics workflows. You will partner with experimental scientists, computational biologists, data scientists, data engineers, platform teams, and IT to capture domain semantics and translate them into well-structured ontology modules, and you will set the semantic standards adopted across the team's data products.

A core purpose of this work is to make our data agent-ready: agentic AI systems cannot reliably navigate, interpret, or act on scientific data without the shared vocabularies, relationships, and constraints that ontologies provide. You will build the semantic layer that lets agents ground their reasoning, retrieve the right data, and connect evidence across experiments, turning fragmented data into knowledge that both scientists and AI can act on.

You will align biologics semantics to our enterprise semantic and governance standards, and collaborate with peer ontologists supporting Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) in the Therapeutics Development & Supply organization so Discovery and downstream semantics stay aligned across the molecule lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Ontology Design, Release & Standards

Model, code, test, and release validated, versioned ontology modules, controlled vocabularies, and mappings across biologics discovery domains, including antibody and protein engineering, assay metadata, molecular design, profiling, automation outputs, sequence/construct knowledge, and developability signals.Publish ontology packages as API-ready semantic assets consumable by knowledge graphs, data products, and AI/ML workflows.Partner closely with biologists, assay scientists, automation teams, and other domain experts to elicit, refine, and translate complex scientific concepts into computable semantic models, balancing scientific accuracy with practical usability and adoption.Express scientific and operational concepts as OWL/RDF classes and properties, SKOS vocabularies, SHACL constraints, and reusable design patterns, and establish the semantic standards adopted across the team's data products.

Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Integration

Partner with data engineers to embed semantic layers into data pipelines, catalogs, and knowledge graph platforms.Model not only scientific entities and concepts, but also the processes, workflows, experimental activities, and decision points that generate and govern those entities, providing the context necessary for interoperability, provenance, and reuse.Enable entity linking, classification, normalization, provenance capture, and semantic search across biologics datasets, and ground agentic AI and retrieval workflows (e.g., knowledge graph and GraphRAG approaches) so agents can reliably navigate, interpret, and act on scientific data.Build and maintain semantic queries (e.g., SPARQL) and automated validation measuring semantic coverage, conformance, lineage, and completeness.

Enterprise & Cross-Functional Alignment

Own semantic alignment with enterprise data governance and knowledge graph standards so Biologics Discovery builds on shared enterprise assets rather than duplicating governance.Harmonize terminology and models with peer ontologists supporting downstream development (CMC) across process, manufacturing, quality, and product lifecycle data, ensuring discovery-to-development handoffs remain traceable and interoperable.Drive consensus across scientific, informatics, and data teams on ontology scope, definitions, and adoption, representing Discovery's semantic needs in enterprise forums.Apply modeling guidelines, naming and versioning conventions, change management, deprecation rules, and semantic quality checks aligned to enterprise governance.

Why This Role Is Unique

This is a rare opportunity to define the semantic foundation for Biologics Discovery and to work at one of its most strategic cross-organizational interfaces: the alignment with enterprise data governance and downstream development partners. You will shape how breakthrough biologics knowledge is captured, connected, governed, and made actionable for scientists and AI systems.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a builder, translator, and systems thinker who is knowledgeable about biologics discovery and energized by its potential to impact human health. They can discuss the science fluently with experimental teams, design rigorous semantic models with technical peers, translate complex biology into machine-readable formats, represent Discovery credibly with enterprise and development partners, and advocate for governance that makes data more reusable without slowing innovation. They are motivated above all by turning connected biologics knowledge into faster, better medicines for patients.

Qualifications

Required

Advanced degree in Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.3+ years in ontology engineering, knowledge modeling, taxonomy design, semantic standards, or knowledge graph development.Hands-on experience with versioning, change management, validation, and release workflows for ontology assets.Proficiency with OWL, RDF(S), SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL, and ontology design patterns.Experience with graph/semantic technologies (e.g., Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, Protégé, RDF triple stores).Ability to translate scientific discussions into semantic models, validation tests, and delivery plans, and to align semantics across teams and partner organizations.Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills in a matrixed R&D environment.Working knowledge of how ontologies and knowledge graphs ground AI and agentic retrieval (e.g., semantic search, RAG, or GraphRAG approaches).

Preferred

Experience in biologics, antibody design, protein engineering, assay biology, or high-throughput experimentation.Experience operating in a governed enterprise environment, preferably pharma or biotech, applying FAIR data principles and enabling interoperability across research and development handoffs.Experience integrating ontology assets into data pipelines, knowledge graphs, search, or agentic AI / GraphRAG tools.Familiarity with OBO Foundry ontologies, UMLS, GO, ChEBI, UniProt, HL7/FHIR, or CDISC.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; Beerse, BE, or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)
